# Why was my card declined?

A card payment can be declined for several reasons. The app shows the reason next to the
declined payment.

## Your card is frozen

If you froze your card in the app, every payment is declined until you unfreeze it.
Go to Cards, choose the card and tap Unfreeze. Payments work again straight away.

## Not enough money

If your available balance is lower than the payment, it is declined. Top up your account
and try again.

## Blocked for a security check

Sometimes we block a card to protect you. Only our support team can lift a security
block, so contact us and we will look into it.
